title: Magnetic properties and spin-only moment
basic_overview: Unpaired electrons give paramagnetism. μ = √[n(n+2)] BM in the spin-only model.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Count unpaired electrons, not total d electrons.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Find d count. 2. Determine spin state. 3. Count n. 4. Calculate μ.
extra_info_content.factors: Orbital contributions are ignored in the spin-only approximation.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
